title: NEW MEDICARE SUBSIDY, DENTAL SUBSIDY, NON-MEDICARE SUBSIDY FOR
text:
[D. CONSENT ITEMS]
NEW MEDICARE SUBSIDY, DENTAL SUBSIDY, NON-MEDICARE SUBSIDY FOR
  QUALIFIED SURVIVING SPOUSES/DOMESTIC PARTNERS, AND MEDICARE PART B
  PREMIUM REIMBURSEMENT MAXIMUMS FOR 2027
summary: Sets the 2027 health subsidy amounts for qualified surviving spouses and domestic partners, covering Medicare, dental and non-Medicare subsidies plus the maximum reimbursement for Medicare Part B premiums.

details.action: consent item setting 2027 subsidy and reimbursement maximums
